description: The onboarding card only offers 'Create your first drive'. The paste-one-line route the landing page promised is not mentioned, and steps 01/02/03 are not clickable. A new user cannot tell whether they or the agent should create the drive.
expected: Show both routes on the first-visit card, or put the llms.txt copy line on it.
actual: Only the browser drive creation button; the agent line is found two tabs away.
suggested_fix: Add the copyable 'Set up Agent Drive: ...' line under the primary button, or a 'Connect an agent instead' secondary link.

description: Right after the user ticks 'I saved my drive key securely' and continues, the Files tab shows a banner saying the drive key has not been backed up. The two statements look contradictory. The command inside the banner is truncated to 'agent-dr...'.
expected: Banner wording that distinguishes 'recovery file not recorded' from the browser save just done, or no alarm banner until an agent exists; the command visible or wrapped.
actual: Red-dot banner 'This drive's key hasn't been backed up...' with the clipped command.
suggested_fix: Mark the key backed up when the user downloads or acknowledges the recovery key, or reword the banner; wrap the code.

description: The 'Connect an agent' paste-line panel is rendered identically on both the Agents and API keys tabs, while the Files empty-state 'Connect an agent' button sends the user to API keys (a tab about keys) rather than Agents.
expected: One home for the panel; the button lands there.
actual: Two copies of the panel; button targets API keys.
suggested_fix: Keep the panel on Agents only and retarget the button.

description: At 390px the llms.txt URL in the dark code block wraps mid-word as 'llms.t / xt'.
expected: Break at the slash or allow the line to scroll horizontally.
suggested_fix: Use overflow-wrap:anywhere only after path separators or reduce font size on small screens.

description: The key receipt dialog gives the key a tall black block (about 75px for a one-line key) and a tiny Copy button, while Save recovery key is full width. Two orange primaries (+ New agent and Create your first agent) compete on the empty Agents tab.
expected: Compact key display with prominent copy; one primary on the empty Agents tab.
suggested_fix: Tighten the key box; demote + New agent when the empty state has its own CTA.
